## Cyclone Akvan weakens, set to hit Odisha-Andhra coast today
URL: https://news.thunderstudy.online/news/cyclone-akvan-weakens-set-to-hit-odisha-andhra-coast-today/
Published: 2026-11-20T01:39:20.161Z
Topic: India
Quick answer: Cyclone Akvan has weakened into a cyclonic storm and is likely to make landfall along the Odisha-Andhra Pradesh coast on Friday. The India Meteorological Department reported the storm moving north-northwest at 21 kmph, centered over the west-central Bay of Bengal at 2:30 am.
Key points:
- Cyclone Akvan weakened to cyclonic storm status
- Expected to cross Odisha-Andhra coast on Friday
- Moving north-northwest at 21 kmph over six hours
- Centered over west-central Bay of Bengal at 2:30 am
Original source: NDTV - https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/cyclone-akvan-live-imd-weather-updates-landfall-rainfall-odisha-andhra-pradesh-akvan-weakens-into-cyclonic-storm-likely-to-cross-odisha-andhra-coast-12352070#publisher=newsstand

## Anthropic raises $81.3 billion in IPO despite $104 billion loss
URL: https://news.thunderstudy.online/news/anthropic-raises-81-3-billion-in-ipo-despite-104-billion-loss/
Published: 2026-11-19T01:41:01.895Z
Topic: Business
Quick answer: Anthropic completed its initial public offering, raising $81.3 billion by pricing shares at $83 and selling more shares than originally planned. The company's revenue surged on the popularity of its Claude Code product, but it simultaneously reported a net loss of $104 billion.
Key points:
- Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in its IPO
- Shares priced at $83 with oversubscribed offering
- Revenue grew as Claude Code gained popularity
- Company reported $104 billion net loss
Original source: Mint - https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/anthropic-raised-81-billion-in-ipo-despite-104-billion-loss-why-wall-street-is-betting-big-on-claude-11795049829392.html

Quick answer: CBSE will train vocational teachers of Classes 9 and 10 in financial literacy and markets for the 2026-27 syllabus. Registration is free and online, and stays open till November 20. The board says financial literacy matters as online transactions, investments and financial services become part of daily life.
Key points:
- CBSE is training Class 9-10 vocational teachers in financial literacy and markets.
- The training is linked to the 2026-27 syllabus.
- Registration is free and done online.
- The registration window closes on November 20.
- CBSE says financial literacy is essential in a digital world.

## Police Ask Top Lashkar Commander Latief Bhat To Surrender In J&K
URL: https://news.thunderstudy.online/news/police-ask-top-lashkar-commander-latief-bhat-to-surrender-in-j-and-k/
Published: 2026-11-18T01:44:28.836Z
Topic: India
Quick answer: Police in Jammu and Kashmir have asked Latief Bhat, described as a top commander of Lashkar-e-Taiba, to surrender through a video call. The appeal follows an encounter in Kulgam on Monday in which his accomplice, Umar Nisar Dar, was killed. Bhat is reported to be trapped in the region.
Key points:
- Latief Bhat is described as a top commander of Lashkar-e-Taiba.
- Police asked him to surrender during a video call.
- His accomplice, Umar Nisar Dar, was killed in an encounter in Kulgam.
- The encounter took place on Monday, according to the source.
- Bhat is reported to be trapped in Jammu and Kashmir.
Original source: NDTV - https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/fresh-encounter-with-terrorists-in-jammu-and-kashmir-kulgam-lashkar-commander-latief-bhat-likely-trapped-12341585#publisher=newsstand

Even if seats remain unchanged in Round 3, candidates can decline to join. This flexibility has led to significant seat underutilisation, with hundreds of medical seats…

- Seats can be declined even after Round 3 allotment
- Flexibility linked to hundreds of vacant medical seats
- Millions of students appeared for NEET 2026

## RBI to auction 91-day, 182-day and 364-day Treasury Bills on Nov 18
URL: https://news.thunderstudy.online/study/rbi-to-auction-91-day-182-day-and-364-day-treasury-bills-on-nov-18/
Published: 2026-11-15T04:15:53.059Z
Topic: Banking
Quick answer: The Reserve Bank of India has announced an auction of three Government of India Treasury Bills on November 18, 2026, totalling ₹23,000 crore. The 91-day and 182-day bills are notified at ₹8,000 crore each, and the 364-day bill at ₹7,000 crore. Settlement is on November 19, 2026.
Key points:
- The 91-day and 182-day bills are notified at ₹8,000 crore each.
- The 364-day bill is notified at ₹7,000 crore, taking the total to ₹23,000 crore.
- Bids will be submitted electronically on the RBI's E-Kuber system on November 18.
- Retail investors can bid non-competitively, capped at 5 percent of the notified amount.
- Successful bidders must pay on November 19, 2026.
Original source: RBI - https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63975
